name: Scout
summary: A mobile wilderness rogue who creates sneak-attack openings by charging and skirmishing.

features.name: Scout's Charge
features.summary: Your charge attack deals sneak attack damage as though the target were flat-footed, unless it has uncanny dodge.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.summary: After moving more than 10 feet, your first attack deals sneak attack as though the target were flat-footed, unless it has uncanny dodge.
